sentences.en: Millions of beneficial organisms live in the human digestive tract.
sentences.zh: 人体内有大量的有益微生物。

sentences.en: An endoscopy is used to examine a person's digestive tract.
sentences.zh: 胃镜用于检查人的消化道。

sentences.en: The liver and the pancreas form part of the digestive system.
sentences.zh: 肝脏和胰腺是消化系统的一部分。
